name: ecommerce-product-detail
context: Design a single product detail page (PDP) for an ecommerce store. The audience is shoppers evaluating a product before purchase, needing high-quality imagery, variant selection, pricing, reviews, and add-to-cart actions. Target platforms: desktop and mobile responsive with touch-friendly interactions.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for price display hierarchy and product descriptions
Apply color.rules.json for sale price highlighting and stock status indicators
Use layout.rules.json two-column grid (media left, details right) on desktop
Image gallery must include alt text and keyboard navigation between slides
Add-to-cart button must be minimum 44px touch target on mobile
Variant selectors must use radio group semantics with clear selected state

outputCriteria.format: Page layout spec with component hierarchy, token references, and responsive breakpoints
qualityChecks: All color values resolve to semantic tokens
Price typography uses weight.strong token for prominence
Image gallery documents loading, loaded, and error states
Add-to-cart documents all button states including loading
accessibilityRequirements: Product images have descriptive alt text
Price changes announced via aria-live on variant selection
Star ratings have text equivalent (e.g., 4 out of 5 stars)
Form controls for variants have associated labels
Quantity input has min/max constraints and aria-valuenow

examples.description: Product info section with price and variant selector
examples.output:
Organism: ProductInfo
  Layout: flex(direction: column, gap: var(--space-md))
  Children:
    - Atom: Text(role=heading, token=typography.heading.lg, color=color.text.primary)
    - Molecule: PriceDisplay
        - Atom: Text(token=typography.heading.md, color=color.text.primary, weight=strong)
        - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text.tertiary, decoration=line-through)
    - Molecule: VariantSelector(role=radiogroup)
        - Atom: VariantOption(role=radio, border=var(--border-default))
        States: unselected, selected(border-color: var(--color-primary), bg: var(--color-surface-selected))
    - Atom: Button(variant=primary, size=lg, label='Add to Cart', width=full)
        States: default, hover, loading(spinner), disabled(out-of-stock)
acceptanceCriteria: Variant selector uses proper radio semantics
All states documented for interactive elements
